name: Fun Push-to-Talk Voice Chat Rooms – World of Chat
author: usearchme00

sections.description:
Try the Live Voice Chat Demo

Bring fun, friction-free push-to-talk voice chat directly into your WordPress site with [worldofchat_voice_room].

How It Works

Think of it like instant voice-note messaging meets a walkie-talkie—no clunky video calls, no downloads, and no mandatory sign-up:

  1. Enter the Room: Logged-in WordPress members automatically join with their display name, while guests can pick any fun callsign (or use an auto-generated guest ID).
  2. Tap & Talk: Hold or tap the mic button to record a quick voice note. Dynamic mic warmup waits for your hardware to stabilize so the start of your message is never cut off.
  3. Send & Play Waveform Voice Notes: As soon as you finish, your message appears in the room as an interactive waveform audio bubble—just like modern mobile voice notes—so everyone in the room can listen live or catch up later.
  4. Stay Clean & Moderated: Recent voice notes are kept for up to 28 days (up to 100 messages), and site administrators can delete any message with one click.

Features

  • One-Click Installation: Upload and activate via WordPress Admin.
  • Simple Shortcode: Drop [worldofchat_voice_room] onto any page, post, or block.
  • WordPress Member Integration: Automatically identifies logged-in members with their display name, while allowing guests to pick custom callsigns.
  • Dynamic Mic Warmup (Walkie-Talkie Mode): Keeps the mic closed until needed and waits for hardware line stabilization to eliminate dead clicks.
  • Playback Silence Trimming: Detects leading silence in under 10ms and plays voice audio immediately.
  • Live Speaking HUD & Online Counter: Shows who is currently transmitting in real time plus active room participant counts.
  • Visual Countdown Ring: Real-time circular progress animation with automatic transmission cutoff.
  • 3 Stunning Built-in Themes: Cyber-Noir Neon, Clean Slate Dark, and Clean Modern Light.
  • Tactical Radio Chirps: Authentic synthesizer start/stop transceiver sound effects.
  • Custom Server URL Support: Connects to the dedicated public relay server out of the box, or your own self-hosted Node.js / Socket.io server.

External Services

This plugin relies on an external cloud-hosted WebSocket signaling server to coordinate low-latency push-to-talk voice transmissions between room participants.

  • Service Provider: Render (Render Services, Inc.)
  • Default Server URL: https://voice-chat-rooms-fwf0.onrender.com
  • Purpose: Coordinates real-time WebRTC and Socket.io signaling handshakes, active room participant presence counts, and ephemeral audio packets between connected room members.
  • When & What Data is Sent: When a visitor enters a voice room and records a voice transmission, ephemeral audio chunks, chosen participant callsigns, and temporary WebSocket session IDs are routed through the signaling server. No personal identifiable information (PII), email addresses, passwords, or WordPress user credentials are ever transmitted or stored on the external service.
  • Render Terms of Service: https://render.com/terms
  • Render Privacy Policy: https://render.com/privacy

Website administrators can also choose to self-host their own Node.js / Socket.io relay server (on their own VPS or server) and enter their custom server URL in Settings > Voice Rooms.

Shortcode Usage

Default:
[worldofchat_voice_room]

Clean Dark Theme:
[worldofchat_voice_room theme=”clean-dark”]

Clean Light Theme:
[worldofchat_voice_room theme=”clean-light”]

Custom Height and 45-Second Timer:
[worldofchat_voice_room height=”800px” max_seconds=”45″]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the world-of-chat-voice-chat.zip file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings > Voice Rooms to configure your server URL, theme, and options.
  4. Add [worldofchat_voice_room] to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Do I need my own voice server to run this plugin?

No. The plugin comes pre-configured with a dedicated public relay server so you can test and use it immediately. For high-volume production websites, you can also host your own Node.js / Socket.io server and enter the URL in Settings > Voice Rooms.

Can visitors use this anonymously?

Yes. Visitors are not required to register or enter an email. They simply pick a callsign (or receive an automatic guest ID) and tap the microphone to talk.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is fully responsive and supports both iOS Safari and Android Chrome touch events with AudioContext unlock gestures.
sections.changelog:
1.5.3

  • Improved Admin “Test Server Connection” button to automatically retry and wait up to 55 seconds with a “Waking up cloud server…” status so sleeping free-tier servers connect on the first click.

1.5.2

  • Restored public cloud relay server (https://voice-chat-rooms-fwf0.onrender.com) as the default server URL for public installations while preserving custom VPS URLs configured in Settings > Voice Rooms.
  • Fixed history lookup for .ogg voice notes so Firefox/Linux recordings persist properly across page loads.
  • Aligned README retention documentation (up to 100 messages / 28 days) with plugin storage settings.

1.5.1

  • Added resilient two-way historical voice note migration between woc-voice and worldofchat-voice folders.
  • Added auto-scan disk recovery to prevent message loss on database reset.

1.5.0

  • Added live “Someone is speaking…” real-time HUD and audio wave presence indicator.
  • Added Admin-Only click-to-bin moderation tool: Site administrators can delete offensive voice notes directly with 1 click.
  • Restricted message deletion capability exclusively to authenticated WordPress administrators.
  • Added smooth auto-scroll to latest message on room load and real-time conversation tracking.

1.4.9

  • Updated unique code, function, class, and option prefixes to worldofchat in full compliance with WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Updated shortcode identifier to [worldofchat_voice_room].

1.4.8

  • Replaced legacy file moving logic with WordPress native wp_handle_upload for full directory compliance.
  • Added CSRF nonce verification across all AJAX endpoints.
  • Fixed audioBlob initialization during recording completion to ensure stable message transmission.
  • Added automatic callsign re-registration on socket reconnect.
  • Enhanced date/time formatting with relative “Today”, “Yesterday”, and full date displays.
  • Added automatic disk modification time fallback for historical voice notes.
  • Extended voice note retention to 7 days with strict 25-message storage cap.
  • Added safe error handling for pruned audio file redirects.

1.4.0

  • Added dynamic microphone hardware warmup to eliminate initial transmission silence.
  • Added instant silence trimming during audio playback.
  • Updated live online user count indicator.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of World of Chat Voice Chat.
